content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) and other related organizations provide various resources designed to support young individuals and their families during transitional periods. These programs are specifically tailored to address key areas such as: Developing effective communication skills to enhance interactions with healthcare providers, as well as improving communication in other settings like school and the workplace. Assisting individuals in navigating the adult healthcare system, which includes guidance on finding new healthcare providers and gaining a comprehensive understanding of health insurance policies and coverage.
